headline: Australian WWE Wrestler Jermaine Haley Known As Bronson Reed Dies
metaDescription: Adelaide-born WWE performer Jermaine Haley, professionally known as Bronson Reed, has died at 38 due to medical complications, according to reports.
aiSummaryBullets: Australian wrestler Jermaine Haley, performing under the name Bronson Reed, has died at the age of 38.
Reports indicate that the performer passed away due to undisclosed medical complications.
The athlete had been scheduled to appear at upcoming WWE events taking place in Perth.
aiContextParagraph: Jermaine Haley, an Adelaide-born professional wrestler who gained international recognition in the WWE under the moniker Bronson Reed, has died at age 38. The news of his sudden passing was confirmed amid reports citing medical complications as the primary cause. Haley leaves behind a family, including a daughter and a wife who is currently pregnant. His death has garnered attention within the sporting community, particularly as his passing occurred only weeks before the WWE was scheduled to host a series of live shows in Perth. Tributes have begun to circulate following the announcement of his death, reflecting on his career and his connection to his Australian roots. As of now, specific details regarding the exact nature of his medical complications have not been publicly disclosed, though the professional wrestling industry has acknowledged the loss of the Australian performer.
whyItIsViral: The death is being covered by two independent news outlets with a moderate velocity of reporting.
